name: Zongkers Custom Woods Inc
old_description: Established in 1989, Zongkers has excelled as an industry leader with premium, handcrafted fine furniture and cabinetry.
about:
Zongkers Custom Woods Inc was founded in 1989 by brothers Dennis and Dan Zongker in Omaha, Nebraska. The family-owned business began as a dedication to preserving the artistry of furniture making, operating from the historic Metz Brewery building near 3rd and Hickory streets.

The company manufactures premium, handcrafted fine furniture and cabinetry, producing each piece individually with an artist's signature to guarantee authenticity. Its capabilities span custom design, engineering drawings, finish sampling, and detailing, with specialties in hand-carving, marquetry veneer inlays, curved furniture, and specialty finishes. The shop serves both commercial and residential projects, fabricating conference tables, reception desks, workstations, dining sets, kitchen cabinetry, entertainment centers, bedroom suites, and liturgical furnishings.

Zongkers serves corporate clients outfitting offices and lobbies, residential customers seeking heirloom-quality pieces, and religious institutions requiring custom liturgical items. The firm's portfolio includes complete commercial interiors, premium kitchens, and specialty carvings such as life-size statues and prayer kneelers.

The brothers built the business on the principle of original, one-at-a-time fabrication, distinguishing themselves from volume-oriented shops by involving clients from concept through finish selection and delivering signed, one-of-a-kind works backed by over 35 years of craftsmanship.
